messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
